tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background – the 'uncoated paper' ground.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table headers on surface-100. Kraft-paper tint.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Form fields and product photo backdrops.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on surface-100/200 (13:1 light, 14:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table meta on surface-100/200 (≥5.2:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Cups1 Navy (from final logo). Logo, headings, links, primary dark fills. 16.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand (navy) fill.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Kraft accent for decorative fills, illustrations and the sample-kit look. Not for text (fails 4.5:1).

tokens.name: kraft-text
tokens.usage: Kraft-coloured text such as eyebrow labels on surface-100 (5:1 light, 8.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Compliance-proof marks only: 'Test report on file', certificate badges (4.6:1 light). Never decorative.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors and blocking warnings only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card and table borders (decorative, not control borders).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, focus-adjacent outlines (≥3:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cups1 Orange (from final logo). Primary call-to-action buttons and highlights. Put navy text on it (6.1:1); never white text (2.7:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent (orange) fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange text on light backgrounds (5.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Leaf green from the logo. Logo and illustrations only; not for text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, product tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Cup-rim pills, status chips; echoes the lid in the logo.
